hooks.text: Exposing your body to space will never make you explode.
A human body exposed to space never bursts apart.
Why does the vacuum of space never make you explode?

title: Why Space Will NEVER Make You Explode
description: Hollywood taught us that space causes human bodies to burst and freeze instantly. Here is what actually happens when you decompress in the void.

beats.text: Exposing your body to space will never make you explode.
beats.visual: photograph of an astronaut during an extravehicular activity in open space, 2006

beats.text: Sci-fi films depict violent ruptures, but human skin easily prevents you from bursting.
beats.visual: diagram showing the layers and tensile strength of human skin, 2020

beats.text: Instant freezing is impossible too, since a vacuum only sheds heat slowly through radiation.
beats.visual: scientific diagram illustrating heat transfer and thermal radiation in a vacuum, 2018

beats.text: Instead, ebullism forms gas bubbles in your tissues, swelling you up to twice your size.
beats.visual: microscope imagery of gas bubble formation and boiling fluid during ebullism, 2015

beats.text: Worse, your lungs reverse function, actively stripping oxygen right out of your blood.
beats.visual: anatomical diagram of human lungs and pulmonary gas exchange, 2019

beats.text: In the mid-1960s, NASA technician Jim LeBlanc accidentally depressurized inside a vacuum chamber.
beats.visual: NASA Space Environment Simulation Laboratory Chamber A vacuum facility, 1965
queries: NASA Johnson Space Center Chamber A

beats.text: Conscious for about fifteen seconds, his last memory was saliva bubbling on his tongue.
beats.visual: NASA technician Jim LeBlanc testing Apollo spacesuit inside vacuum chamber, 1966

beats.text: Crews repressurized the room within thirty seconds, leaving him without any permanent damage.
beats.visual: NASA engineers inside the altitude chamber control room monitoring spacesuit test, 1966

beats.text: You have ninety seconds before hypoxia turns fatal, but your skin keeps you entirely intact.
beats.visual: Earth curvature and blackness of space photographed from low Earth orbit, 2021

better_than_last: Eliminated the dangling conjunction in beat 9 to ensure a complete, grammatical sentence that seamlessly loops back to beat 1.
